title: Layerwise Repacking: Variable-Length Hybrid-Attention Training without an Extra Redistribution Pass
abstract: arXiv:2610.35989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variable-length training creates conflicting parallelism requirements across the layers of a hybrid-attention model. The longest samples require wide sequence-parallel (SP) groups of 16 or 32 ranks for full attention, whose cost grows quadratically with sequence length. Sparse-attention layers, dominated by near-linear MoE work, can instead balance most evaluated workloads within node-local SP8 groups. Reusing the wide groups for these layers pushes their all-to-all communication across nodes, where the observed effective rate is 7.0x lower. Yet switching to smaller groups changes which ranks own each sample; a separate redistribution at every full-sparse boundary would introduce another data transfer.   Layerwise Repacking keeps each SP16/32 parent for full attention and repacks its samples into node-local sparse children at SP{1, 2, 4, 8}, where hidden states persist between full layers. translated_title: 逐层重打包：无需额外重分配过程的变长混合注意力训练
translated_abstract: 变长训练在混合注意力模型的各层之间产生了相互冲突的并行需求。最长的样本在全注意力层需要16或32个进程的宽序列并行（SP）组，其成本随序列长度呈二次方增长。稀疏注意力层主要由近线性的MoE计算主导，因此在节点本地的SP8组内即可平衡大多数被评估的工作负载。如果这些层继续复用宽组，其all-to-all通信将跨越节点进行，观察到的有效速率降低了7.0倍。然而切换到更小的组会改变每个样本由哪些进程持有；在每个全注意力-稀疏注意力边界处进行单独的重分配将引入另一次数据传输。逐层重打包（Layerwise Repacking）为全注意力保留每个SP16/32父组，并将其样本重打包到节点本地的稀疏子组中，在完整注意力层之间保持隐状态。该布局变化借助两个现有的功能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出逐层重打包方法，使混合注意力模型的变长训练中全注意力层使用宽SP16/32组、稀疏注意力层使用节点本地的小SP组，无需在层间边界进行额外的数据重分配，从而避免跨节点all-to-all通信7.0倍的性能损失和额外传输开销。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Layerwise Repacking, which enables variable-length hybrid-attention training by keeping wide SP16/32 groups for full-attention layers while repacking samples into node-local smaller SP groups for sparse-attention layers without an extra redistribution pass, avoiding the 7.0x slower cross-node all-to-all communication and additional data transfer overhead.
